scope: Implementation run only: original supervisor turn plus four descendants including provenance follow-ups; excludes analysis request.
models: All five sessions recorded gpt-6-astra with high reasoning effort.

findings.finding: Supervisor planning, orchestration and reporting used 40.65% of all tokens.
48 of 107 model-facing tool calls coordinated agents; 28 waits, 17 timeout returns. Root wait time overlaps useful child work.
Four child provenance follow-up turns used 484601 tokens and 11 model responses. Almost all were reused context.
All verification gates passed first attempt; no implementation repair. Three nonzero shell exits reflected optional discovery and integrity/bookkeeping assertions, not failed app behavior.
Artifact footprint reflects the mandated workflow plus redundant metadata.

recommendations: Capture response-level telemetry automatically with exact session and turn identities; the original unavailable-counter report was avoidable.
Generate manifests, hashes, receipts and reports from one structured execution record to reduce repeated authored metadata and rereading.
Scope integrity checks to immutable inputs and owned candidate paths; keep mutable agent logs out of broad workspace snapshots to avoid metadata-only alarms.
Use one followup_task for an idle worker when a reply is needed; avoid send_message followed by followup_task for the same question.
Retain independent review and final assembled verification. Reduce empty polling within the progress-update constraints and favor completion notifications.
limitations: Cached tokens are included in total input; reasoning tokens are included in output and not added again.
Dollar cost unavailable without billing data; no estimate made.
Model-facing tool counts differ from nested shell/patch events and child subprocess counts.
Elapsed time is actual original task-start to task-complete interval. usage.json raw event span includes inter-turn events; usage-bounded.json applies explicit turn boundaries.
Original reports remain historical evidence; this supplement supersedes their unavailable token/tool counters.
